newsitem.title: USA: Dynatech sells three units for $61 million.
newsitem.headline: Dynatech sells three units for $61 million.

text.p: Dynatech Corp., a maker of high technology products, said Wednesday that it has sold three non-strategic businesses to separate buyers for a total of $50 million in cash and $11 million in notes and preferred stock.

The three businesses are: Computerized Medical Systems Inc., a supplier of radiation therapy planning software; Dynatech Video Group Inc., a maker of professional video editing and production equipment; and the international distribution unit of Dynatech Communications Inc., a packet and matrix switch business.
